# PassKi

> Passkeys for Kotlin Multiplatform: one `Passkeys()` API for Android (Credential Manager), iOS (AuthenticationServices) and the web (navigator.credentials). Your server creates WebAuthn options and verifies responses; PassKi shows the native passkey sheet and returns typed `PasskeyResult`s with setup errors that name a check ID and a fix.

Key facts: options JSON in, response JSON out; `Passkeys()` needs no Activity or UIWindow; errors are `PasskeyError` with `category`, `fixHint`, `checkId` and `docsUrl`; `FakePasskeys` (passki-test) produces responses real server libraries verify; RP IDs are bare domains and can't change later.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): Your KMP app and your own server to a first verified passkey, on Android, iOS and the web
- [Try it](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/try-it.md): The sample app, or your app against the hosted demo server
- [Concepts](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): How a passkey ceremony works, and the terms (RP ID, user handle, well-known files, check ID)
- [Usage](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/usage.md): Install, every call (register, signIn, signInOrPassword, upgrade, signals, capabilities), results and errors
- [Platforms](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/platforms.md): What each OS version and browser supports, threads and cancellation, platform differences
- [Compose](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/compose.md): PasskeySignInButton, PasskeyUsernameField and sign-in state
- [Autofill](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/autofill.md): Passkeys as keyboard suggestions with your own text field
- [PRF and largeBlob](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/extensions.md): PasskeyExtensions: encryption keys and data stored with a passkey
- [Testing](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/testing.md): FakePasskeys: real signed responses for app and server tests
- [Logging](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/logging.md): PassKi.logLevel, PassKi.logHandler, what is never logged
- [Setup tooling](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/setup.md): Gradle plugin (passkiSetup, passkiCheck), PasskeyDoctor, setting up by hand
- [Security model](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/security-model.md): PassKi never verifies or stores; what the server must check

## Guides

- [Passkeys as an extra sign-in](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/extra-sign-in.md): Settings, the sign-in button, list, delete and relabel with signals
- [What to show users](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/what-to-show-users.md): One row per PasskeyError and PasskeyErrorCategory
- [Choosing your RP ID](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/choosing-rp-id.md): The permanent decision: apex or subdomain, web and apps, hosting
- [Choosing user name and display name](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/user-names.md): User handle rules, account labels, Hide My Email
- [Recommended server API](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/server-api.md): Endpoints, request and response shapes, status codes
- [Verifying on the server](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/verify-on-server.md): webauthn4j and java-webauthn-server examples with FakePasskeys tests
- [Upgrading users](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/upgrading-users.md): When upgrade() creates a passkey without a sheet
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): Symptom first: AND-03, Play builds, IOS-02, the web

## Setup checks

- [Check catalog](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/README.md): every check ID used by errors, PasskeyDoctor, passkiCheck and the web verifier
- [AND-01](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/AND-01.md): assetlinks.json reachable
- [AND-02](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/AND-02.md): Login credentials delegated to the app
- [AND-03](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/AND-03.md): Signing certificate listed
- [AND-04](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/AND-04.md): Google Digital Asset Links agrees
- [AND-05](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/AND-05.md): Play App Signing key listed
- [AND-06](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/AND-06.md): PassKi initialised in the app
- [IOS-01](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/IOS-01.md): apple-app-site-association reachable
- [IOS-02](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/IOS-02.md): App listed under webcredentials
- [IOS-03](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/IOS-03.md): Apple CDN has the app
- [IOS-04](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/IOS-04.md): Entitlements list webcredentials
- [IOS-05](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/IOS-05.md): Entitlements wired into the Xcode build
- [IOS-06](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/IOS-06.md): Built app carries the entitlement
- [SRV-01](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/SRV-01.md): Server RP ID matches
- [SRV-02](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/SRV-02.md): Server allows all origins
- [SRV-03](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/SRV-03.md): Server options are valid WebAuthn
- [CFG-01](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/CFG-01.md): RP ID is a bare domain
- [DEV-01](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/DEV-01.md): Android device can store passkeys
- [DEV-02](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/DEV-02.md): iOS device can use passkeys
- [DEV-03](https://github.com/rezaiyan/PassKi/blob/main/docs/checks/DEV-03.md): Platform supports passkeys
